subject: Re: Interest in Redwood for GitHub / OSS integration — demo?

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@opensourcedb.org>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Interested in Redwood — GitHub integration questions

Hi Camila,

I signed up for a trial earlier today after seeing Redwood mentioned on a GitHub repo discussion (we're contributors to OpenSourceDB). We're evaluating hosted inference for a metadata/assistant feature and I'm particularly interested in how Redwood integrates with GitHub Actions and repo-based CI for model updates.

Questions I have up front:
- Can Redwood pull from a private repo (via GH App or deploy keys) to trigger model deployment?
- Any example of a CI workflow to update a deployed model when a release/tag is made?
- Do you provide sample code for embedding generation in a Node.js + GitHub Actions setup?

If helpful I'd love to schedule a quick demo to see the integration workflow and ask a few architecture questions. I'm on US Pacific time; mornings are best for me.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Johnson
Senior Engineer, OpenSourceDB
https://github.com/ajohnson
